content.short: Mera derives EVM and Solana accounts straight from a passkey, with no seed phrase or MPC service.
content.description: Mera is a TypeScript library from Category Labs that derives standard EVM accounts directly from a passkey using the WebAuthn PRF extension, with no seed phrase, bundler, MPC service or backend custody involved. Users create and recover accounts with Face ID, Touch ID or a security key, and the same passkey reproduces the same accounts in a web app and its native iOS or Android build. The derived accounts are ordinary BIP-44 EOAs, so an exported mnemonic imports cleanly into MetaMask or Rabby, and the library can derive Solana accounts from the same passkey. Signing sessions zero their keys when ended, and account derivation, recovery and storage stay under the application's control.
content.meta: Passkey-derived EVM and Solana accounts as a library, with no seed phrase, bundler or MPC service.
